m.s: Rinse {brownrice} until the water runs clear. Put it in a saucepan with twice its volume of cold water and a pinch of salt. Bring to the boil, then cover and cook on low for 25 minutes. Take it off the heat and leave the lid on for 5 minutes.

Put {chk_breast} in a saucepan and cover with cold salted water. Bring to a gentle simmer over medium heat, then turn off the heat, cover and leave for 15 minutes until cooked through (75°C in the thickest part). Let it cool a little, then shred with two forks.
Stir together {fishsauce}, the juice of {lime}, {brownsugar}, finely chopped {garlic} and {chilli}, and 1 tbsp water per serve until the sugar dissolves. Taste: salty, sour, sweet and hot.
Shred the cabbage as thin as you can. Cut {carrot} and {cucumber} into matchsticks. Pick the leaves from {mint} and {coriander}, and roughly crush {peanuts}.
Toss the veg, chicken and most of the herbs with the dressing until everything is coated.
Serve over the rice, topped with the peanuts and the rest of the herbs.

l: Pack the dressing separately and toss just before eating so the salad stays crunchy. Keeps 3 days in the fridge.
g: Naturally gluten free. Check the fish sauce.
